description: DONE (folded 2026-07-03 as dc26bf0b0, two-lane audited PASS/PASS). Filled 31 of ~34 return-type-equivalence TODOs in port_type_infer_test.rs — each asserts the function's settled return type via types_equivalent_for_test (delegates to production Types::is_equivalent mutual-subtype check, NOT a leniency shim), across int/str, module-qualified (Enum.reduce/3 vs Enumerable.List.reduce/3), tuples (flat/nested/mixed), unions (int|float), and CallableValueKind (FnRef vs Closure). Audit spot-checked 8 sites + mutation-tested (tuple-position wrongness, FnRef<->Closure kind discrimination) — all bite. Helpers extracted after 3 conversions: attach_return_captures[_with_modules], assert_settles_to[_in_module] (31 sites), assert_closure_kind (3 sites — collapsed from two helpers at fold per the removable nit). pub(crate) bump of ModuleCapture::new/handler + function_id_in_module (all consumed). 3 TODOs left as DOCUMENTED FINDINGS (not forced false assertions): plain_spawn (child never activated, no return fact — correct to skip), and TWO CONFIRMED BEHAVIORAL BUGS ticketed below (guard-clause non-narrowing; map-pattern dead-clause leak). Baseline 1161/0/24 unchanged (strengthened assertions, no new tests). 8 remaining rg 'TODO' are out-of-scope (fixpoint-Known-return / activation-path / diagnostic checks), not return-type-equivalence.
title: Sweep the 34 remaining return-type TODOs in port_type_infer_test.rs
